text:
Type: trailing ivy houseplant
Use: greenery on a shelf, a windowsill or in a hanging planter; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: bohemian, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: live ivy with glossy lobed leaves, terracotta-colored plastic nursery pot
Colors: deep green, variegated light green and cream, terracotta
Shape: bushy mound of small lobed leaves with long trailing vines that spill over the edge, small pot, loose and flowing
Feel: fresh, natural, lively, relaxed
Goes with: wood shelves, white walls, woven baskets, ceramic cachepots; bohemian or Scandinavian rooms
